in_sanskrit.name: सत्यप्रकाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Satyaprakash is derived from the Sanskrit words सत्य (satya), meaning truth, reality, or essence, and प्रकाश (prakash), meaning illumination or light. Together, the name can be interpreted as 'the illumination of truth' or 'the light of reality'.
